[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 20
- Description: KAN-122 filed + backlog entry for the KAN-102 decision-tagging residual
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1961
  
  Details:
  Work on 2026-11-28, following KAN-102 closeout. Scope: open the KAN-102 residual as a tracked ticket and file it in the cross-session backlog, so the remaining gap does not evaporate with the ticket that revealed it.
  
  === KAN-122 created and assigned ===
  "Loop classifier: distinguish reaction go-signal anchors from real decision prompts (residual of KAN-102)"
  Status To Do, priority Medium, assignee admin+sophia (verified by read-back).
  
  Assignee resolution required a correction. jira_query(myself) returned Gary Teh, because the Jira API token belongs to the governor. "Assign to yourself" is therefore NOT myself — trusting it would have put the ticket on the wrong person. Found the real Sophia account from KAN-31, which is assigned to admin+sophia, then resolved it to accountId 712020:96b5508c-475a-4bab-b6c0-441ad3d7c2ce via a dry run before applying.
  
  === Backlog entry: agentic_ai_context PR #1961 (merged e48323aa) ===
  One entry added at the top of ## Pending in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md.
  
  Duplicate checks before writing: search_context "KAN-102" -> 0 hits, "decision-tagging" -> 0 hits. Confirmed OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md is the single backlog file (no TODO.md variant created).
  
  The entry records, so a future session does not have to rediscover it:
  - The discrepancy itself: KAN-102's FIX specified decision-tagging at load_awaiting(); what shipped (#673) was goal-terminality gating at the classifier.
  - Verified gap against deployed main c50cc7f: load_awaiting() still returns all entries; no kind / is_decision field in app/; no clear-on-complete path.
  - Live proof: the single awaiting_stale after deploy had goal status open, not terminal.
  - The scale failure mode already documented in LOOP_DAEMON_PLAN.md: _discord_resume_awaiting.json reached 2430 entries with no GC, at which point nearly every Discord channel classifies AWAITING and the signal drowns.
  
  Two traps called out explicitly for whoever picks this up:
  1. Do NOT filter what goes INTO the registry. mark_resume_awaiting() on every message is what makes any emoji reaction a go-signal (KAN-31 / SOPHIA_EMOJI_REACTION_GO_PLAN.md). Filter only what the classifier reads as a pending question.
  2. app/loop_daemon.py now holds load_goal_ages() (#613) and load_goal_states() (#673), which share a "return out" trailer. A careless conflict resolution during #673's rebase dropped it and caused 14 test failures, caught only because the suite was run after rebasing. Re-run the full suite after any rebase touching this file.
  
  Also proposed a concrete shape: a kind: "go_signal" | "decision" field defaulting to go_signal so all existing entries stay reaction-resolvable, set to decision only from the resume_awaiting=True and options[]/mark_options paths, read through a narrow load_decision_awaiting() accessor, with entries cleared or superseded on complete_thread_goal / dismiss_thread_goal. Plus four acceptance tests mirroring KAN-102's.
  
  === Honest note on scope ===
  This is bookkeeping and specification, not code. No behavioural change shipped this turn. The actual classifier distinction remains unbuilt and is now tracked in two places by design (Jira for execution, OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md so cross-session agents see it without Jira access).
  
  No ledger writes. No deploys. No irreversible actions. Docs-only PR, so the code-gate suite did not apply.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 33.33
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
